title: synoreclaim cleanup plan result v1
description: `cleanup plan` (SPEC 5.7): the checked selection grouped by shared folder and the saved plan that moves it into the shared folders' Recycle Bins; nothing moves yet. A refusal is the envelope alone.

size.description: Entries (the item and everything below it on its filesystem), files, and their allocated size (st_blocks x 512). Moving them frees nothing until the Recycle Bin is emptied.

admin_only.description: Only administrators can see and restore the Recycle Bin's items.

drive.description: In a user's Synology Drive folder: its clients sync the move.

symlinks.description: Symlinks it holds, itself included; absent when none. DSM's Recycle Bin drops symlinks, and folders holding only symlinks, on a move, as File Station's delete does; restoring does not bring them back.

item_count.description: Selected items in this shared folder.

drive_items.description: How many of them are in a user's Synology Drive folder.

items.description: The first 100 of them: a preview, not every item.

symlinks.description: Symlinks its items hold, counted from the scan report; absent when none. When the items move to the Recycle Bin, DSM drops these symlinks and folders holding only symlinks.

delete.description: No Recycle Bin takes its items, so apply removes them for good, only with confirm_delete (cleanup apply --confirm-delete); delete_reason says why. Absent when they move to the Recycle Bin.

delete_reason.description: Why its items are removed for good: no_shared_folder, a folder right below the volume that is no DSM shared folder; recycle_bin_off, a shared folder whose Recycle Bin is off (turning it on and making a new plan moves them to the Recycle Bin instead). Present with delete.

share.description: One shared folder's selected items: they move to its Recycle Bin, or, without one, are removed for good (delete).

items.description: How many items the plan moves or removes for good.

deletes.description: How many of the items have no Recycle Bin (no shared folder, or its Recycle Bin is off) and are removed for good.

paths.description: The first 100 items the plan moves: a preview, not every item.

duplicates.description: What a duplicates selection expanded to.

anyOf.description: A refusal: errors[] names each refused path and why (protected_target, in_recycle_bin, selection_boundary, target_changed, recycle_bin_unavailable, cleanup_disabled, keeper_changed, ...).
